The '''''Stellar Halo''''' was a [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruiser]] that served as part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-aligned [[Kuati Sector Forces]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], in which the Galactic Empire fought the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and later its successor state, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Along with the rest of the [[Kuati/Legends|Kuati]] Sector Forces, the ''Stellar Halo'' guarded the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]]. Rebel forces [[Taking of Kuat|attacked]] Kuat in [[8 ABY/Legends|8.5 ABY]], managing to take control of Kuat even with the protection of the Kuati Forces. In the wake of the battle, undercover Imperial [[Agent/Legends|agents]] [[Undercover attack on Kuat|activated]] the ''Stellar Halo''{{'s}} [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], sending it into Kuat's [[Kuat (star)|sun]] and destroying it.

==Description==
A [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]], the ''Stellar Halo'' was a [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruiser]] equipped with a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].<ref name="Warfare" />

==History==
Part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]&ndash;affiliated [[Kuati Security Forces]]<ref name="Warfare" /> as of [[8 ABY/Legends|8.5 ABY]],<ref name="Atlas" /> the ''Stellar Halo'' guarded the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] with the rest of the Kuati [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. The planet, home to the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]], had long been a key [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and its predecessor, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. With the Galactic Empire fighting the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and its successor state the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Kuat was [[Taking of Kuat|attacked]] in 8.5 ABY by the New Republic, as military forces attempted to seize the shipyards from the Empire.<ref name="Warfare" />

Arriving in the [[Kuat system/Legends|Kuat system]], the [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptors]] of the New Republic [[Surprise Squadron]] soon disabled the systems of the battlecruiser [[Luminous (battlecruiser)|''Luminous'']] and three [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] using their [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion]] [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedoes]], while a [[Coded eraser virus|virus]] caused the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] [[Event Horizon (battlecruiser)|''Event Horizon'']] and four [[Star/Legends|Star]] [[Destroyer/Legends|Destroyers]] to turn against the rest of the fleet. After the New Republic [[Minister of Commerce]], [[Ral'Rai Muvunc]], informed the lead Kuati officials that the Republic controlled thirty-four percent of the KDY stocks, Kuat surrendered to the Republic as they faced an enemy that could disable nine warships in a matter of [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] and controlled a substantial portion of the company. Shortly after the battle, undercover Imperial [[Agent/Legends|agents]] managed to [[Undercover attack on Kuat|activate]] the ''Stellar Halo''{{'s}} hyperdrive and launched it into Kuat's [[Kuat (star)|sun]], thus destroying the battlecruiser.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Stellar Halo'' was first mentioned in [[2012]]'s ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', an extensive [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|guide]] dedicated to the conflicts in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="Warfare" />
